XY series · AOR

Ancient Origins

Released August 12, 2015 · 100 cards

Expanded

Ancient Origins is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the XY series, released in English on August 12, 2015. Its main set has 98 cards, plus 2 secret rares numbered beyond the set (100 in total). It includes 82 Pokémon, 17 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

43 illustrators worked on Ancient Origins. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (16), Ryo Ueda (9), Toyste Beach (6), Eske Yoshinob (5), Kouki Saitou (3), TOKIYA (3), Akira Komayama (2), Ayaka Yoshida (2).
